method: Read-only source audit, no production requests or mutations

resultsVisibility.liveV6: Reveal AI scores, owner-only Freeze final scores, Reveal Final score each disable when data.readiness.scoring.ready is not true.
resultsVisibility.readinessDefinition: settings version>0, active event, zero policyBlockers. The disabled click itself changes nothing.
serverPrerequisites: AI reveal requires explicit PUBLIC_AI confirmation, eligible current-version completed finalized provider evaluations; mocks cannot qualify
Freeze requires owner and valid actual scoring prerequisites
Final reveal requires explicit PUBLIC_FINAL confirmation and current-policy frozen snapshot with confirmed criteria/weightage
resultsVisibility.remedy: Confirm the actual unresolved scoring decisions and satisfy real evaluation/snapshot prerequisites; never invent weights or bypass controls.
resultsVisibility.v7Ui: Consumes resultControls.ai/freeze/final allowed+reason derived by integration backend; absent projection disables safely with Reload result controls. No manual readiness checkbox UI remains.

participantImport.sequence: Add participants → Single email / Email list / CSV → Add → count/email confirmation → Confirm
participantImport.internalValidation: Add internally calls preview-import for validation, exact new count and digest; no separate user-facing Preview step. commit-import consumes matching digest after confirmation.
participantImport.csvMapping: A CSV without an explicitly recognizable email column asks for mapping; no column is guessed.

adminReview.sequence: Submissions → project row → /admin/submissions/{slug} → Project details / Review
controls: Final rubric when actual prerequisites permit
AI evaluation status and re-evaluation when configured
adminReview.authority: canReview returns admin for owner or every admin without assignment. Assignment gates apply to judge/mentor roles.
adminReview.assignedProjectsNavigation: Only judge and mentor roles receive /review Assigned projects navigation; admin rows already link directly into Submissions detail.

credits: See evidence/v6-credit-ui-audit.json: liveV6 exposes shared instructions and inventory counts but no upload/allocation UI. Visible attendance controls do not allocate. No API workaround or production action executed.
